mapper.select: select d.id as dispatchId, d.order_id as orderId, d.response_deadline as responseDeadline, d.created_at as dispatchAt, o.order_no as orderNo, o.service_name as serviceName, o.start_date as startDate, o.days as days, o.time_slot as timeSlot, o.city as city, o.district as district, o.community as community, o.detail as detail, o.entry_mode as entryMode, o.pay_amount as payAmount, o.remark as remark from order_dispatch d join orders o on o.id = d.order_id where d.provider_id = #{providerId} and d.action = 'DISPATCH' and o.status = 'PENDING_ACCEPT' and d.response_deadline > now() and not exists ( select 1 from order_dispatch d2 where d2.order_id = d.order_id and d2.provider_id = d.provider_id and d2.action in ('ACCEPT', 'REJECT') and d2.id > d.id ) order by d.id desc

select d.* from order_dispatch d join orders o on o.id = d.order_id where d.action = 'DISPATCH' and d.response_deadline < now() and o.status = 'PENDING_ACCEPT' and not exists ( select 1 from order_dispatch d2 where d2.order_id = d.order_id and d2.provider_id = d.provider_id and d2.id > d.id )
